prs.title: fix: fail fast when session is not started

prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: ClientSession can be used incorrectly relative to its async-context-manager lifecycle: methods can be invoked without ever entering `async with session:`, or the session can be re-entered while already running. members.title: Fix: Raise RuntimeError when ClientSession is used without context manager to prevent hangs
members.author: newbiehwang
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2631: ClientSession can be used incorrectly relative to its async-context-manager lifecycle: methods can be invoked without ever entering `async with session:`, or the session can be re-entered while already running. Both PRs independently add the same `_entered: bool` flag on ClientSession to detect and fail fast on this.

clusters.pick_reason: #3056 scopes the fix narrowly to `str | None` (matching its title/tests exactly), leaving pre-parsing behavior unchanged for other union shapes like `str | int` or `str | bool`. #2032's `_should_pre_parse_json` instead skips pre-parsing for ANY union whose members are all in {str, int, float, bool, NoneType}, a broader behavior change not covered by its test additions. #3056 also adds `_unwrap_annotated` to strip `Annotated[...]` wrappers before the union check, while #2032's `is_union_origin(get_origin(annotation))` check does not unwrap `Annotated` first, so `Annotated[str | None, Field(...)]`-style parameters (the idiomatic way to attach a description to a param, per #3056's own docstring) fall through to the default `return True` and remain unfixed under #2032's implementation.
